bagPolicy.summary: Large bags, backpacks, and similar items are strictly prohibited at PeoplesBank Arena. Handbags of normal size may be allowed after a search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available around PeoplesBank Arena and throughout Downtown Hartford, with 45 lots and garages. Metered street parking is free from 6:00 pm to 8:00 am and all day on weekends. Prices vary and are managed by third-party companies.

rideshare.note: Let Lyft be your ride to the action! Use code PEOPLESBANK for 50% off your first 2 rides (up to $10/ride).

concessions.note: PeoplesBank Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including New England style BBQ, specialty baked potatoes, and unique pizza flavors like Peanut Butter & Bacon. Visitors can also enjoy a variety of beverages from local craft beers to mixed drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by PeoplesBank Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in PeoplesBank Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On event days, The Hartford Ticket Office will be open 4 hours before the start of the event No third party will call or alternative pickup will be accepted at the Hartford Ticket Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at PeoplesBank Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
